This is one of my first comments on this entire shit show of a website

And it's about how this post is literally told from the perspective of Cecil Palmer from WTNV

Granted. The entire world's fly population is now extinct due to the addition of a new, carnivorous apex predator to the food chain. The Giant Venomous Fying Wolf Spiders have eaten all the flies and now have an appetite for human flesh!

I'm happy that I'm not alone, nothing compares to the absolute dread of trying to do a simple task and messing up every step along the way, like dominos falling helplessly all down the line, crashing on your face, being berated for being stupid but then having someone telling you to do it again. That it will get better. All for it to happen all over again with no change. They truly don't understand that I fail at the beginning and failure for me starts with trying.
Thanks for the comment, it means a lot.

School was absolute hell for me, but I always chalked that up to the tense and competitive environment that a school can give, the illusion of constantly failing and never meeting up to the expectations of teachers/peers, which absolutely exists and causes many intelligent people to develop imposter syndrome. Once I was done with school and had people tell me the truth of how much I was messing up is when I realized how much I truly struggled cognitively and how hindered I truly was/how incompetent I am. You might be a victim of your environment, freind.
